Jai Shree Ram
Sri Guru Charan Saroj Raj, Nij Mann Mukuru Sudhaari.\nBarnaun Raghuvar Bimal Jasu, Jo Daayaku Phal Chaari.
Buddhiheen Tanu Janike, Sumiraun Pawan-Kumar.\nBal Buddhi Vidya Dehu Mohi, Harahu Kalesh Bikaar.
Jai Hanuman Gyan Gunn Sagar. Jai Kapees Tihun Lok Ujaagar.\nRamdoot Atulit Baldhama. Anjani-Putra Pawansut Naama.
Mahaveer Vikram Bajrangi. Kumati Nivaar Sumati Ke Sangi.\nKanchan Baran Biraj Subesa. Kaanan Kundal Kunchit Kesa.
Haath Braj Au Dhwaja Biraaje. Kaandhe Moonj Janeu Saaje.\nShankar Suvan Kesarinandan. Tej Prataap Maha Jag Vandan.
Vidyavaan Guni Ati Chaatur. Ram Kaaj Karibe Ko Aatur.\nPrabhu Charitra Sunibe Ko Rasiya. Ram Lakhan Sita Mann Basiya.
Sukshma Roop Dhari Siyanhi Dikhawa. Bikat Roop Dhari Lanka Jarawa.\nBheem Roop Dhari Asura Sanghare. Ramchandra Ke Kaaj Sanware.
Laaye Sanjeevan Lakhana Jiyaaye. Sri Raghuveer Harashi Urr Laaye.
Raghupati Keenhi Bahut Badai. Tum Mum Priya, Bhartahi Sum Bhai.\nSahas Badan Tumharo Jas Gaave. Asa Kahi Sripati Kanth Lagaave.
Sanakadik Brahmadik Munisa. Narad Sarad Sahit Ahisa.\nJam Kuber Digpal Jahan Te. Kavi Kovida Kah Sake Kahan Te.
Tum Upkar Sugreevahi Kinha. Ram Milaye Raj Pad Dinha.\nTumharo Mantra Bibhishan Mana. Lankeshwar Bhaye Sab Jag Jana.
Jug Sahastra Yojan Par Bhanu. Leelyo Tahi Madhur Phal Janu.\nPrabhu Mudrika Meli Mukh Mahin. Jaladhi Langhi Gaye Achraj Nahi.
Durga Kaaj Jagat Ke Jete. Sugam Anugrah Tumhare Tete.\nRam Duaare Tum Rakhvaare. Hot Na Aagya Binu Paisaare.
Sab Sukh Lahe Tumhari Sarna. Tum Rakshak Kahu Ko Darna.\nAapan Tej Samhaaro Aapai. Teenon Lok Haank Te Kaapai.
Bhoot Pisaach Nikat Nahi Aavai. Mahaveer Jab Naam Sunavai.\nNaasai Rog Hare Sab Peera. Japat Nirantar Hanumat Beera.
Sankat Te Hanuman Chudavei. Mann Kram Vachan Dhyan Jo Lavai.\nSab Par Ram Tapasvi Raja. Tinke Kaaj Sakal Tum Saja.
Aur Manorath Jo Koi Lavai. Soyi Amit Jeevan Phal Paavai.\nCharon Yug Pratap Tumhara. Hai Parsiddha Jagat Ujiara.
Sadhu Sant Ke Tum Rakhvaare. Asur Nikandan Ram Dulaare.\nAshta Siddhi Nau Nidhi Ke Dataa. As Var Deen Janki Maataa.
Ram Rasayan Tumhare Paasa. Sadaa Raho Raghupati Ke Daasa.\nTumhare Bhajan Ram Ko Paavai. Janam Janam Ke Dukh Bisraavai.
Antakaal Raghubarapur Jayi. Jahaan Janma Hari Bhakta Kahayi.\nAur Devata Chitta Na Dharayi. Hanumat Sei Sarva Sukh Karayi.
Sankat Kata Mite Sab Peera. Jo Sumirai Hanumat Balbeera.\nJai Jai Jai Hanuman Gusai. Kripa Karahu Guru Dev Ki Nai.
Jo Sat Baar Paath Kar Koi. Chhutahi Bandhi Mahaa Sukh Hoi.\nJo Yeh Padhe Hanuman Chalisa. Hoye Siddha Saakhi Gaurisa.
Tulsidas Sada Hari Chera. Keejai Nath Hriday Mah Dera.
Pawan Tanay Sankat Haran, Mangal Murti Roop.\nRam Lakhan Sita Sahit, Hriday Basahu Sur Bhoop.
Hanuman Ji Blessed You!!
Hanuman Chalisa
